07 / Blinksquare Events · Growth Intern

I joined for growth. Ended up doing a bit of everything.

Six months at Blinksquare taught me what it really means to take ownership. From marketing campaigns and social media to event operations, logistics, influencer outreach, design, and content creation, I got to explore almost every side of the business. What I loved most was the independence—I wasn't just following instructions; I was experimenting, making decisions, creating reels and campaign assets, and figuring things out along the way. Results: 700K+ campaign impressions, 20+ micro-influencer collaborations, 15+ customers acquired for our DIY kit, and 100+ responses to our 'Buy' CTA. I joined to understand growth; I left understanding how much work goes into making it happen.
